units.source_text: 到了着裳仪式那一天，三条邸的太君悄悄地派一个使者前来送礼。

en.t: On the day of the robe ceremony, the old lady of the Sanjo residence quietly sent a messenger with gifts.

units.source_text: 虽然时日匆促，但她所备办的梳具箱等礼品，非常精美而体面。

en.t: Although the time was short, the comb box and other gifts she had prepared were extremely fine and dignified.
She also enclosed a letter for Tamakazura:

units.source_text: “我乃尼僧之身，恐有不吉之嫌，本来不该参与庆祝。

en.t: As I am a nun, I fear I may be thought inauspicious, and by rights I should not take part in the celebration.

units.source_text: 虽然如此，但我之长寿，想来值得教你模仿。

en.t: Even so, my long life, at least, may be something worth having you imitate.

units.source_text: 你的身世，我已详悉，使我不胜眷恋。

en.t: I have learned the full story of your birth and circumstances, and it has made me deeply fond of you.

units.source_text: 若无一言相祝，岂非不合情理？

en.t: Would it not be against all feeling and reason if I did not offer even a single word of congratulations?
I wonder what you think of this.
